info.name: School_Management_System
info.description: School Management System — three top-level folders split by role: Admin (AdminJwtAuthGuard), Teacher (@Roles('teacher')), Parent (@Roles('parent')).

exec: if (j && j.access_token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('admin_token', j.access_token); console.log('admin_token saved'); }

request.description: Authenticate as admin. access_token auto-saved to {{admin_token}}.
Create a new admin account. Accepts multipart for optional image.
Retrieve a single admin by ID.
Update admin details. All fields optional.
Admin creates a user account and assigns a role.
Retrieve a single user by numeric ID.
Lookup a user by email address.
Link a permission to a role.
Assign a role to an admin account.

item.name: Get Admin Role Assignment by ID

request.description: Reassign a role to an admin.
Remove a role from an admin.
Assign an elevated role to a user.

item.name: Get User Role Assignment by ID

request.description: Reassign a role to a user.
Remove a role from a user.
Directly assign a permission to an admin.
Change which permission is assigned to an admin.
Remove a direct permission from an admin.
Directly assign a permission to a user.
Change which permission is assigned to a user.
Remove a direct permission from a user.
Create teacher + linked User + assign 'teacher' role. Requires 'teacher' role (guard: user) in roles table.
Update teacher. Syncs name/email/phone to linked User.
Delete teacher record. Linked User is preserved.
Create guardian + linked User + assign 'parent' role. Returns temporary_password.
Update guardian. Syncs name/email/phone to linked User.
Delete guardian. Linked User is preserved.
Create a class. class_teacher_id and section are optional.
Retrieve class with teacher name and email.
Delete class. Blocked if students are assigned.
Enroll a student. class_id and guardian_id are required.
All students with class_name and guardian_name.
Create a subject. code must be unique.
Delete subject. Blocked if mapped to any class.
Map a subject to a class with an optional teacher. Unique on (class_id, subject_id).
All subjects + assigned teachers for a class.
All class+subject assignments for a teacher.
Reassign or unset the teacher for a class-subject mapping.
Bulk upsert attendance for a class. status: present | absent | late.
All attendance records for a class on a date. Includes marked_by_name and marked_by_type.
Full attendance history for a student. Includes marked_by_name.
Correct a single attendance record's status.

body.raw:
{
  "class_id": 1,
  "subject_id": 1,
  "teacher_id": 1,
  "title": "Chapter 3 — Algebra Exercises",
  "description": "Complete exercises 1–20 from the textbook.",
  "due_date": "2026-09-20"
}

request.description: Create assignment + auto-generate pending submissions for all students in the class.
All assignments with class_name and teacher_name.
Grade a student's submission. status: pending | submitted | late | graded.

exec: if (j && j.data && j.data.access_token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('teacher_token', j.data.access_token); console.log('teacher_token saved'); }

request.description: Authenticate as a teacher. access_token auto-saved to {{teacher_token}}.
Returns the class where this teacher is assigned as homeroom teacher, or a message if unassigned.
Mark attendance for your own class. Teacher must be class_teacher_id for class_id. Same DTO as admin mark.
View your class's attendance sheet for a date. Ownership enforced.

body.raw:
{
  "class_id": 1,
  "subject_id": 1,
  "title": "Algebra Worksheet",
  "description": "Complete all odd-numbered questions in chapter 4.",
  "due_date": "2026-09-25"
}

request.description: Create an assignment for a class you teach. subject_id required. teacher_id in body is ignored — set server-side. ClassSubjectTeacher mapping must exist.
All assignments where teacher_id = this teacher.
Single assignment with submissions. Ownership enforced.
Update title, description, or due_date only. class_id/subject_id/teacher_id are locked.
Delete your own assignment. Cascades to all submissions.
Grade a student's submission. Parent assignment must belong to this teacher.

exec: if (j && j.data && j.data.access_token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('parent_token', j.data.access_token); console.log('parent_token saved'); }

request.description: Authenticate as a parent. access_token auto-saved to {{parent_token}}.
All children linked to the authenticated guardian's profile (name, class, roll_no, identity_number).
Attendance history for one of your children. 403 if student_id doesn't belong to your guardian profile.
All assignment submissions for one of your children — includes title, due_date, status, marks_obtained, feedback. 403 if student_id doesn't belong to your guardian profile.
